content:
Apple TV is kicking off its fall lineup this week with the new film *Mayday*, starring Ryan Reynolds — a buddy comedy that's also an action spy movie. The first reviews say it's a winner.

Reviews for *Mayday* are praising the action, the humor, and the chemistry between the two leads.

Apple TV is best known for its series — currently airing gems like *Ted Lasso* and the sci-fi shows *Dark Matter* and *Silo*. But Apple TV's movies are gaining more attention too.

Beyond the 15 classic films newly added for subscribers, Apple has several high-profile original films debuting soon, with *Mayday* leading the pack.

*Mayday* premieres on Apple TV on Friday, September 4 (watch here).

The film stars Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh, and is directed by John Francis Daley and Jonathan Goldstein — a team behind *Game Night*, *Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves*, and co-writers of *Horrible Bosses*.

*Mayday*'s reviews just dropped, and they're overwhelmingly positive. Here are some excerpts:

  • JoBlo: "*Mayday* is hands down the best non-theatrical film of the year, and one of the best pure streaming-platform movies I can think of."
  • Empire: "When you hear 'a buddy comedy action movie starring Ryan Reynolds,' you probably think you know what you're getting — some snappy fights, endless quippy dialogue, and a reasonably fun time. *Mayday* delivers all of that, and a little bit more."
  • The Hollywood Reporter: "This popcorn film, powered by the off-key comedic chemistry of its two leads, proves to be an entertaining diversion that leaves you hoping for the sequel it teases."

Many reviewers noted that *Mayday* feels like it should — and even needs to — be seen on the big screen.

Sharp execution of action, likable humor, and Reynolds' lead performance add up to a movie that, in another era, could absolutely have been a summer box-office hit.

Either way, Apple TV subscribers can stream it for free starting this week.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, or you can bundle it through the Apple One deal.
